item.text:
Rendered the requested 1000×1000 eigenvector partition with radius-1 singularities:

- [Eigenvector partition PNG](/workspace/Ocean_eigenvector_partition.png)
- [Degenerate-point data CSV](/workspace/Ocean_degenerate_points.csv)
- [Reproducible render script](/workspace/render_ocean_partition.py)

Detected 86 degeneracies: 41 white wedges and 45 pink trisectors.
